- **W3-1 (`CF-S115-S0-KNOB-CROSS-SUBSTITUTION-CONFIRM`)** — re-runs the S101 W3 S0-knob discrimination with candidate (iii) routed at the *located* van Hove crossing `q = 0.191038` (= canonical `tau_cross_van_hove`, S114) instead of the canonical fold value `q = 19/100`, with the bit-equality guard relaxed to the substituted value, to mechanically confirm the GRADED selector still selects (iii) and the gate still PASSes; then Sage-confirms `CF(0.191038/0.112)` carries no clean small-denominator convergent so the `S0 = 95/56` exact identity has NO analog at the located value. **CONFIRMS-CANNOT-FLIP** the S114 W-1 verdict (the exact-rational asymmetry is regulator-free arithmetic).

- **W3-3 (`CF-S115-B5A-TFD-QES`, OPTIONAL, Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING)** — replaces the closed-form linear bracket interpolant `R_TFD = R_edge + f·(R_island − R_edge)` (which FAILed at every single-/two-sided causal-patch route) with a full two-sided island quantum-extremal-surface extremization of `S = Area(∂I)/4 + S_bulk-EE(I)` over the island boundary `∂I`, to test whether the `A/4` microstate count is reachable by a NON-causal-patch mechanism.

## §W3-2. CF-S115-AS-NEWAXIS-SELECTOR  —  OPTIONAL (planner-discretion, EVOI-last)

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----
gate_id: "S115-AS-NEWAXIS-SELECTOR"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "transit-dynamics-theorist"
hypothesis: "A functional-determination principle NOT in {impulse-quench, UNIFIED-AS-79, Parker-adiabatic} — specifically (axis-1) maximum-entropy/Jaynes selection on the post-transit occupation n_k, OR (axis-2) Connes-distance-canonical normalization of the relic spectral functional — collapses the 1.2590-OOM cross-functional A_s spread to a single typed value (PASS); OR no new-axis selector collapses the spread, widening FUNCTIONAL-PLURALISM-PERMANENT on a broader axis-basis (FAIL)."

# ---- OPTIONAL disposition ----
# OPTIONAL (planner-discretion, EVOI-last). Source: session-114-w4-workingpaper.md
# §"Carry-Forward Computations" L171-176 (context item 5). §EVOI.BF already prices A_s magnitude
# as a permanent physical d.o.f. (S114 W4-1 FAIL = PLURALISM-PERMANENT); this gate WIDENS the
# no-selector evidence on a fresh axis-basis, it does NOT change the headline. The user may elect
# to drop this gate at the Phase-3b checkpoint. RETAINED EVOI-ordered last rather than dropped
# (carrying a clearly-scoped low-EVOI gate costs little; dropping a recommendation loses it).

method:
  description: >
    Test two pre-registered new-axis selectors against the same D_K-derived occupation spectrum
    that underlies the three existing functional A_s values, asking whether either collapses the
    cross-functional spread. Load the box-delta sudden Bogoliubov |beta_k|^2 spectrum
    (s100b_box_delta_bogoliubov.npz) — the MAGNITUDE source — and the three functional A_s literals
    (impulse-quench A_s_FW=1.536706e-8 / UNIFIED-AS-79 3.297762e-9 / Parker-adiabatic 5.987138e-8).
    AXIS-1 (maxent/Jaynes): construct the maximum-entropy occupation n_k^maxent = argmax_{n_k}
    [ -sum_k (n_k ln n_k - (1+n_k) ln(1+n_k)) ] subject to the substrate-fixed constraints
    (mean pair number <N> = sum_k |beta_k|^2 from the box-delta spectrum; total energy
    <E> = sum_k omega_k |beta_k|^2 in M_KK clock units) — the GGE/Jaynes prediction for the
    relic — and compute A_s^maxent = |beta_khat^maxent|^2/(2 pi^2) at the same k_hat=1/xi_KZ
    normalization the impulse-quench floor uses (S111-CF-AS3a). AXIS-2 (Connes-distance):
    normalize the relic spectral functional by the Connes spectral distance d_Connes between the
    in-vacuum and out-vacuum states on the substrate spectral triple (A_K, H_K, D_K) — a
    substrate-canonical normalization that is NOT a sudden/slow-roll/adiabatic choice — and compute
    A_s^Connes. PASS iff EITHER axis yields A_s^newaxis lying within 0.10 OOM (DIAGNOSTIC collapse
    band) of BOTH the impulse-quench AND at least one other functional (i.e. the selector picks a
    SINGLE typed value, collapsing the >=1.259-OOM spread to <=0.10 OOM). FAIL iff neither axis
    collapses the spread (A_s^newaxis is a FOURTH scattered value OR coincides with only one
    pre-existing functional). The three pre-existing A_s are the SPREAD; the box-delta |beta|^2 is
    the per-mode source the selectors re-weight.
  producing_script: "computations/session-115/s115_as_newaxis_selector.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "PASS iff exists axis in {maxent, Connes} : max( |log10(A_s^axis) - log10(A_s_impulse)|, |log10(A_s^axis) - log10(A_s_2nd)| ) <= 0.10 for some 2nd functional in {UNIFIED, Parker} ; i.e. the selector collapses the >=1.259-OOM spread to <= 0.10 OOM around a single typed value"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.10 (OOM collapse band — DIAGNOSTIC, NOT a Planck-comparison gate; the spread to collapse is 1.2590 OOM)"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "null — the maxent occupation is a constrained-optimization output and the Connes distance is a numerical spectral-triple computation; neither boundary is closed-form. The 0.10-OOM collapse band is a pre-registered diagnostic threshold (an order-of-magnitude tightening of the 1.259-OOM spread), chosen at plan-freeze, NOT analytically derived."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "2"                              # 2 new-axis selectors {maxent/Jaynes, Connes-distance}
  L_max: "12"                              # the box-delta spectrum + Connes triple evaluated on the L12 D_K cache (matches A_s_FW lineage S111)
  scan_range: "N/A — fixed |beta_k|^2 spectrum from s100b_box_delta_bogoliubov.npz; maxent is a constrained solve, not a scan"
  step_size: "N/A — maxent via Lagrange-multiplier root-find (scipy.optimize.brentq on the two constraint equations); deterministic"
  tolerance: "1e-10"                       # maxent constraint-satisfaction residual + Connes-distance convergence ; collapse band 0.10 OOM (the PASS threshold)
  scheme: "AS-NEWAXIS-SELECTOR-MAXENT-CONNES"
  convention: "OOM-COLLAPSE-DIAGNOSTIC"    # log10 A_s spread; DIAGNOSTIC-only, NOT a Planck-comparison gate (per S114 memory: Planck threshold log10(1.05)=0.02119 is diagnostic-only)
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (maxent root-find + spectral-distance are deterministic)"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"                 # the Connes-distance leg evaluates the L12 D_K spectral triple (>=100x100 ⇒ torch.linalg.eigvals on ROCm RX 9070 XT per math-scripts.md); the maxent leg is scalar (cpu)
  # No Seeley-DeWitt a_n cited -> no regulator_pin. No SCHEMATIC helper -> no CLASS pin.
  # publication_precision: "6"            # A_s^newaxis published at 6 sig figs (matches A_s_FW=1.536706e-8 publication precision)

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
```
